headers.description: Optional headers to send with the request as a dictionary of header values.

Content-Type.description: The media type of the resource being requested, typically 'application/json'.

Authorization.description: The credentials to authenticate a user agent with a server, typically formatted as 'Bearer {token}'.

timeout.description: The maximum amount of time to wait for a response from the server, in seconds. A longer timeout may be necessary for slower network connections or overloaded servers. This is a float type value.

params.description: URL parameters to append to the URL. Sent as a dictionary of key-value pairs.

query.description: The query parameter for search or filtering.

page.description: The page number parameter for pagination. Used to retrieve a specific page of results.

auth.description: HTTP authentication credentials formatted as a (username, password) tuple.

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem), if required for the request.

cookies.description: Cookies to send with the request as a dictionary of cookie names and values.

sessionid.description: Session identifier cookie, used to recognize client sessions on the server.

csrftoken.description: CSRF protection token cookie, used to prevent cross-site request forgery attacks.

proxies.description: Proxy settings as a dictionary, mapping protocol or protocol and hostname to the URL of the proxy.

http.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTP requests, including the port number.

https.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTPS requests, including the port number.

stream.description: Whether to stream the download of the response. If False, the response content will be immediately downloaded. Streaming is useful for handling large files or responses.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not. Set to False to skip certificate verification, which is not recommended unless you are sure of the server's identity.

message.content:
Here are a few well‑known IP‑lookup APIs that return company‑level data (including contact details when available). All of them support a simple HTTP GET request that you can call from your own code or via the `functions.requests_get` helper.

| API | What it offers | Typical response fields | Pricing / Limits | Notes |
|-----|----------------|------------------------|------------------|-------|
| **IPinfo** (`https://ipinfo.io`) | Geo‑location, hostname, company, carrier, ASN, and optional contact info (email, phone) | `ip`, `hostname`, `city`, `region`, `country`, `loc`, `org`, `postal`, `timezone`, `company` (name, domain, type, phone, email) | Free tier: 50k requests/month, paid plans start at $5/month for 1M requests. | Very easy to use; JSON response; free tier includes company data. |
| **ipstack** (`https://api.ipstack.com`) | Geo‑location, currency, timezone, company, and optional contact info | `ip`, `type`, `continent_code`, `continent_name`, `country_code`, `country_name`, `region_code`, `region_name`, `city`, `zip`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `location` (includes `geoname_id`, `time_zone`, `currency`, `languages`), `company` (name, domain, type, phone, email) | Free tier: 10k requests/month, paid plans start at $9.99/month for 50k requests. | Good for commercial use; company data available in paid tiers. |
| **ipdata.co** (`https://api.ipdata.co`) | Geo‑location, ISP, ASN, company, and optional contact info | `ip`, `city`, `region`, `country_name`, `country_code`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `asn`, `asn_org`, `isp`, `company` (name, domain, type, phone, email) | Free tier: 1k requests/day, paid plans start at $19/month for 100k requests. | Offers a generous free tier; includes phone/email for many companies. |
| **ipapi** (`https://ipapi.co`) | Geo‑location, currency, timezone, company, and optional contact info | `ip`, `city`, `region`, `country_name`, `country_code`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `asn`, `org`, `company` (name, domain, type, phone, email) | Free tier: 30k requests/month, paid plans start at $9.99/month for 100k requests. | Simple endpoint; company data in paid plans. |
| **MaxMind GeoIP2 Precision Services** (`https://geoip.maxmind.com`) | Geo‑location, ISP, ASN, company, and optional contact info | `ip`, `city`, `country`, `postal`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `asn`, `isp`, `company` (name, domain, type, phone, email) | Paid only (starting at $0.0005/request). | Enterprise‑grade data; very accurate; requires account and license key. |

### How to call one of these APIs

Below is a quick example using the `requests_get` function to query IPinfo. Replace `YOUR_TOKEN` with your actual API key.

```python
response = functions.requests_get({
    "url": "https://ipinfo.io/8.8.8.8/json",
    "headers": {"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"},
    "timeout": 5.0
})
print(response)
```

The JSON response will look something like:

```json
{
  "ip": "8.8.8.8",
  "hostname": "dns.google",
  "city": "Mountain View",
  "region": "California",
  "country": "US",
  "loc": "37.3860,-122.0840",
  "postal": "94035",
  "timezone": "America/Los_Angeles",
  "org": "AS15169 Google LLC",
  "company": {
    "name": "Google LLC",
    "domain": "google.com",
    "type": "Internet Service Provider",
    "phone": "+1-650-253-0000",
    "email": "support@google.com"
  }
}
```

### Choosing the right provider

| Use case | Recommended API | Why |
|----------|-----------------|-----|
| **Free or low‑volume projects** | IPinfo (free tier) | 50k free requests/month, includes company data. |
| **Higher volume, budget‑friendly** | ipstack or ipapi | Both offer 10–30k free requests/month and inexpensive paid plans. |
| **Enterprise‑grade accuracy** | MaxMind | Highest precision, but requires a paid license. |
| **Need phone/email for many companies** | ipdata.co | Free tier includes phone/email for many entries. |

Feel free to pick the one that best matches your traffic volume and budget. Once you have an API key, you can use the `functions.requests_get` helper to make the calls directly from your code.
